These layoffs represent approximately 1% of the company's global workforce, with senior software engineers and engineering managers being the most affected roles.

aggregation_stories.summary: McCain Foods has appointed Victoriano Perez Mies, formerly of PepsiCo, as its new chief manufacturing and operations officer. This move follows the departure of Attila Tamer in early 2025 and coincides with Peter Dawe's increased focus on McCain's global snacking business.
